blurb: Guests ride a tram car 1,800 feet from sea level through the rainforest to the Mountain House on Mount Roberts. At the top, guests can hike trails including to a sub-alpine meadow with panoramic views. The site includes a restaurant, gift store, and cultural experiences at the lower terminal.
extraNote: Tram hours vary each day and are subject to change due to inclement weather conditions on the mountain. · Downtown Juneau cruise ship dock lower terminal
